v1.1.2.note: Official relay only, CSP hardened, PRO features

v1.1.3.note: Security fix: SCP-1 packets and ENV-1.2/ENV-F senders are bound to the verifying key; SCP-1 payload checked against the signed hash; a notice is valid only when its work chain recomputes

v1.2.0.note: Security fix for findings F-1 to F-7 of an external review of 1.1.3: envelopes ENV-1.3 sign the whole clear header and content; notices carry ln_bind, a second signature over the whole notice including the work chain; exact canonicalization without NFC; minimum work rounds; 128-bit fingerprints; sender checks fail closed. Includes the unpublished 1.1.4 fixes (file envelopes ENV-F-2). Older formats stay readable as older format, never as valid. Formats are not externally audited.

v1.2.1.note: Security fix for a second independent review of 1.2.0: key bundles sign their encryption key (bsig; bundles without it need a confirmed bundle fingerprint), biometric unlock only with WebAuthn PRF and no wrapping key in storage or backups, the notice card checks the signer against your contacts, stricter passphrases, import fields as text only, compact keys refused as recipients, CSP for the verify page. Formats are not externally audited.
